degree_rationale: Five Works (or Four) of the Great Sin — care of mouth/food, sexual intercourse/fornication, wealth/property, war/contention. The structures of evil in human life over which men kill each other. Then: faith, separation of light from dark in only-begotten godhead.
direction_rationale: South-turn at the natural: wisdom now illumines what humans pursue — the four/five great drives of natural life named and contrasted with the saving knowledge. The illumination of human moral life.
grand_man_function: Natural moral illumination — the named human passions vs. faith.
title: Five Works of the Great Sin (lust, pride, war, etc.)
